title: Wayfare Pass Billing Standard — Collecting Membership Fees
content:
# Collecting membership fees — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Clauses in force

1. **Billable statuses.** Membership fees are collected only on a membership in enrolled, trial, active or past due status. The membership's status on record decides, before the fee is collected.
2. **Renewal.** The renewal fee is collected on the day after the last day of the current period when auto-renew is on; the next period begins on that day. A membership in pending cancellation is never renewed, and a paused membership is not charged until the pause ends.
3. **Card partner memberships.** A membership taken out through a card partner offer is never billed by Wayfare.
4. **One charge per period and reason.** Each period is paid by exactly one fee charge per reason (initial, trial conversion, renewal or plan change proration); a second collection for the same period and reason is a duplicate and is refunded in full with refund basis duplicate charge.
5. **Period end.** The period ends on the day before the same day-of-month, the plan's period length in calendar months later, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist (the plan's period-end rule).

## Retired clause

> The fee for a period is the plan's membership fee. Under this clause an initial, trial conversion or renewal charge was the plan's membership fee.

This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded and is kept here as the earlier text of this standard only. Only the fee clause is retired: the period-end rule beside it is clause 5 above and remains in force.

## Status table for collecting a fee

Clause 1 is a complete list ("only"), so every status has an answer.

| Membership status | Fee may be collected? |
|---|---|
| enrolled | yes |
| trial | yes |
| active | yes |
| past due | yes |
| paused | no |
| pending cancellation | no |
| cancelled | no |

## Hypothetical cases

- A membership with auto-renew on whose current period ends on 14 April has its renewal fee collected on 15 April, when the next period begins.
- The same membership with auto-renew turned off (pending cancellation) is not renewed on 15 April.
- Two renewal charges are found for the same period: the second is a duplicate and is refunded in full with refund basis duplicate charge.
- A membership enrolled through a card partner offer shows no Wayfare fee charges, and none is collected.
- Under clause 5, a monthly period that starts on 15 March ends on 14 April; one that starts on 31 January ends on the last day of February; an annual period that starts on 10 June ends on 9 June of the following year.

superseded_clauses: The fee for a period is the plan's membership_fee;
